facts.value: Four orange/yellow cysts (1 on the back, exposed early; 3 across chest/stomach). Explosive canisters stagger it. Each burst cyst can spawn Blister Heads from nearby corpses.

Leon's boss fight at the Care Center Chapel/Courtyard; Blister Borne also recurs as a field enemy (East Raccoon City Sewage Facility). Fight escalates qualitatively as cysts pop (poison clouds, more aggression) — no verified HP phase thresholds.
Real boss. Two encounters: Grace (optional, East Wing) and Leon (Attic).
Giant spider boss in a ruined building in East Raccoon City. Weak point: orange cluster on the abdomen.
Scripted story beat: after the helicopter crash Emily mutates and attacks Grace; Leon shoots her non-fatally. Not player-conditional. Later cured by Elpis in the true ending.
Official in-game name is 'The Girl'. 'Shadow Ghost' is a community/guide alias. Not the canonical name.
